entity.summary: Crypto-asset wallet and trading service combining lending, custodial account and wallet functions, crypto-to-crypto swapping, card purchase access, and a project model that describes smart-contract-based permissionless finance. The service remains active and has documented integration with CryptoPanda as a separate partner service.
entity.notes: The current first-party service exposes account-based wallet, lending, swap and crypto-purchase functions. First-party project documentation describes permissionless smart-contract-based lending, swap and token-management architecture, while the live support surface documents email/password accounts, managed balances, internal transfers and service-side transaction history. HEI therefore uses hybrid rather than classifying the service as purely centralized or purely decentralized. The first-party company page identifies Izakaya Limited and a Hong Kong operating address, supporting Hong Kong as country_or_origin. It states a service start month of December 2023, but because no exact day is established HEI leaves launch_date null. IZAKA-YA and CryptoPanda are treated as separate entities; their documented integration is recorded as a partnership event rather than an alias or lineage relationship.

events.title: IZAKA-YA and CryptoPanda ran linked-service collaboration campaign
events.description: IZAKA-YA published a collaboration campaign requiring users to register with both services, link IZAKA-YA with CryptoPanda, and complete a CryptoPanda transaction connected to an IZAKA-YA wallet.
events.notes: The event establishes a documented service integration/collaboration. It does not imply common ownership, merger, acquisition, predecessor/successor status, or that the two services are the same entity.

evidence.title: IZAKA-YA public service site
evidence.notes: Current first-party site presents active lending, crypto-to-crypto swap, wallet and crypto-purchase functions. Promotional yield, security and compliance claims are not independently adopted by HEI.

evidence.title: IZAKA-YA company profile
evidence.notes: First-party company page identifies Izakaya Limited, a Hong Kong operating address and a December 2023 service start month. HEI uses the operator/location evidence for country_or_origin but does not invent an exact launch day.

evidence.title: IZAKA-YA project purpose
evidence.notes: First-party project documentation describes permissionless smart-contract-based lending, swapping and token management. Used to support the hybrid service classification; forward-looking ecosystem claims are not treated as completed features unless corroborated by the live service.

evidence.title: How to use the IZAKA-YA wallet
evidence.notes: Official support documentation states that users can manage cryptocurrencies, lend, swap, deposit, send and review balances/transaction history through the service.

evidence.title: IZAKAYA x CryptoPanda IZKY token campaign
evidence.notes: First-party campaign page documents linked registration and a CryptoPanda transaction connected to an IZAKA-YA wallet. Used to establish the collaboration/integration event only.
